abbreviations.evidence: Label appears directly above numeric value in CF Rate section (e.g. MR / 89). Confirmed by context: MR changes between races.
Column header AR in historical performance table, followed by integer rating per race row.
Column header SR appears in historical table row near winning time. Values correlate with race times.
Appears as second value in the Sp Rate / RR block below CF Rate section. Short-term form indicator.
CF Rate Headgear label. The value before it (e.g. A 46) is the CF grade letter + CF rate number.
Column heading F/B on overview pages contains fractional odds matching bookmaker board prices.
Column header OB in historical table, followed by fractional odds string.
Column header SP in historical table. Official tote/bookmaker starting price.

abbreviations.possible_meaning: Weight Performance Rating or Winning Performance Rating
abbreviations.evidence: Appears as WPR: 16-3200m. Correlated with best distance performance. Exact formula unconfirmed.
Dcat: N-W-S-T-U pattern with career stats. Groups distances: Sprint/Mile/Middle/Stayer.
CRSE: N-W-S-T-U pattern. Context confirms it is course-specific career record.
Dist: N-W-S-T-U pattern matching today race distance stats.
C&D: N-W-S-T-U pattern. Standard racing abbreviation, confirmed in context.
Hdgr: N-W-S-T-U after headgear code. Stats correlate with headgear changes.

abbreviations.possible_meaning: This jockey on this horse stats
abbreviations.evidence: J+H: N-W-S-T-U. Confirmed — matches jockey assigned to horse.
J+T: N-W-S-T-U. Standard SA racing statistic.
Column header W/Time followed by seconds value (e.g. 119.93).
Column header 400F followed by time in seconds (e.g. 23.5).
Column header Adjtpm. Value format .06160 (seconds/metre). Used to compare across distances.

abbreviations.possible_meaning: Delta between peak and mean performance
abbreviations.evidence: Best vs Ave: +1.90 appears in bio block. Positive means best exceeds average.

abbreviations.evidence: Column H/Av in historical table. Values appear as signed floats (+1.1). Exact formula unknown.
